title: Equip Slot
content:
Type: EQUP
Papyrus: EquipSlot Script The equip slots are used to define a position on an Actors body to which an item can be equipped. Weapons and Armor typically designate equipment slots such as the left hand, right hand, chest, etc. Editor Dialog: thumb|right|400px - - Condition Actor Value: The Actor Value to use as the condition for this equipment slot. - Slot Parents: A collection of parent equipment slots. - Use All Parents: If checked, this slot takes up all of the parent slots. If not checked, this slot takes up only one of the parent slots, but it can be any one of the parents. - Parents Optional: - Item Slot: Notes: - Items marked with the same slot can't be equipped simultaneously. Attempting to equip one will automatically unequip the other. See Also: - Race - Armor - Weapon - Actor Value - Character Category
